## Line 410

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/splines.library.plato, line 410](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/splines.library.plato#L410).

```plato

    //==
    // # Kochanek-Bartels (TCB) splines
    //
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kochanek%E2%80%93Bartels_spline
    // Tension flattens the curve at the knot, Bias skews the tangent toward the
    // incoming or outgoing chord, and Continuity breaks the tangent into
    // distinct arriving and departing halves. Each half is a weighted sum of
    // the two chords meeting at the knot; the four weights are pure Number
    // expressions shared by both dimensions.

    // The weight the departing tangent gives the incoming chord (p_i - p_i-1):
    // (1 - t)(1 + b)(1 + c) / 2.
    TcbOutgoingBackWeight(tension: Number, continuity: Number, bias: Number): Number
        => (1.0 - tension) * (1.0 + bias) * (1.0 + continuity) * 0.5;
```
